name: Senture (Partner)
desc:
750 Open Seats-Urgent Hiring- Healthcare Member Advocate | $14 - $17/hr | Phone Heavy, Healthcare Billing & Benefits Support

Company: Senture
Industry: Healthcare (BPO) | Member Services & Advocacy
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 This role has you supporting a healthcare client's members through both inbound and outbound calls, helping with billing questions, quoting, understanding medical or pharmacy benefits, requesting materials, and researching claims. The posting is explicit that this isn't just a service role, you're expected to genuinely advocate for members, making the process easier for them and following through until their concern is actually resolved, not just closed out.
You'll use several web-based systems to research and resolve inquiries, document everything accurately, and follow up with callers as needed. There's a real performance component too, contact center data is used to improve your performance over time. Training here is notably long: 7 weeks, fully paid, with 100% attendance required.
The application process has a real gatekeeping step: required assessments (a "Digital Interview") must be completed from a computer or laptop before a recruiter will even review the application.
assessment:
Important: You must complete assessments! Recruiters will not review your application submission until all assessments are complete.
At the end of the application, you’ll see a screen titled “Digital Interview.” Please wait a moment for the purple link to load—this will take you to the required assessments. These must be completed from a computer or laptop. Assessments must be completed before moving forward in the process.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED.
 Required Experience: Not strictly required, though prior call center or customer service experience is highly desired.
 Preferred Experience: Prior healthcare-related customer service background.
 Required Skills:
Effective verbal and written communication
Ability to multitask across multiple windows/tabs
Comfort navigating web-based systems and internet search engines
Ability to sit for extended periods
Ability to pass a background investigation and drug screen
Ability to pass pre-employment criteria testing and an internet speed test
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone with prior call center or healthcare customer service experience who wants to genuinely advocate for members, not just process calls
Participants who already have qualifying non-cellular high-speed internet (fiber, DSL, or cable) meeting the 20 Mbps down/12 Mbps up minimum
Military veterans and military spouses, specifically encouraged to apply per the posting
Anyone who can commit fully to a 7-week, 100% attendance training period
Not a Good Fit for:
Participants unable to complete the required digital assessment from a computer or laptop
Anyone using hotspot, satellite, or wireless internet, explicitly not allowed
Someone who can't commit to the demanding call center hours (Monday-Friday 8 AM-9 PM EST, Saturday 9 AM-7:30 PM EST) or the full 7-week training
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 Per the posting directly: complete the application, then look for a screen titled "Digital Interview" at the end, wait for the purple link to load, and complete all required assessments from a computer or laptop. Recruiters will not review the application until every assessment is complete.

Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Healthcare customer service
Member advocacy
Billing and claims support
Medical/pharmacy benefits
Database documentation
Multi-system navigation
Customer inquiry resolution
Remote customer service
Healthcare BPO
Contact center performance metrics


4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell me about a time you truly advocated for a customer rather than just resolving their immediate question.
How do you stay organized researching a claim or benefits issue across multiple systems?
Describe your experience with healthcare billing, benefits, or insurance, if any.
How do you handle a caller who's frustrated about a billing or coverage issue?
What does committing to a 7-week, fully attended training program look like for you?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $14-$17/hr range. Confirm directly during the recruiter screen.
Shift: Full-time, fully remote. Call center hours: Monday-Friday 8 AM-9 PM EST, Saturday 9 AM-7:30 PM EST. Training: 7 weeks, fully paid, 100% attendance required.
Benefits: Competitive benefits, PTO, growth and development opportunities. Specific benefit details not broken out in this posting.
Equipment Provided: Yes, all equipment provided. Employee must supply their own non-cellular high-speed internet (fiber, DSL, or cable modem, minimum 20 Mbps download/12 Mbps upload); hotspots, satellite, and wireless internet are not allowed.
Felony Friendly?: Not confirmed either way in outside research specific to Senture. Background investigation and drug screen are confirmed as required conditions of employment.
Drug Test: Confirmed as part of the pre-employment process (background investigation and drug screen required per posting).
Notes: Senture's own careers page confirms a real scam warning: recruiting communication only comes from an @senture.com email, background check questionnaires come from @instascreen.net specifically, and Senture never uses Telegram or asks for payment during the hiring process, worth passing along to participants directly. The 7-week training period with 100% attendance is longer than most postings in our database, set that expectation clearly. Weekend (Saturday) coverage is required as part of the call center's operating hours.
Career Pathway: Healthcare Member Advocate → Senior Member Advocate → Team Lead → Member Services Supervisor → Member Services Operations Manager
